title: hibiscus lobatus
intro: Hibiscus lobatus, commonly known as the "Pride of Madras," is a flowering plant species in the mallow family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing cholesterol levels, and acting as a natural diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and other polyphenolic compounds, which may provide protection against oxidative stress and cellular damage.
